thread:
Alex Kim: Hey team — kicking off the trial environment for AcmeHealth POC. Scope: 2-week eval to validate extraction + PII redaction + retrieval latency at 99th pct. Need: sample dataset (approx <=50k rows), connectivity path (Snowflake/S3/SFTP/VPC), redaction checklist, and a minimal pricing estimate. Who can pick up provisioning and the security questionnaire?

Maya Patel: I can own sandbox provisioning. Quick Q: do they prefer Snowflake read-only role or a presigned S3 upload? Also do we need VPC peering/private endpoint for the POC?

Elena Ruiz (AcmeHealth): We store data in Snowflake. We can grant a read-only role or export a CSV. PHI fields must be redacted before any export; we can provide a de-identified export to start. Timeline: we'll aim to hand off sample by Tuesday EOD.

Samir Shah: I'll take the security questionnaire and DPA checks. Two asks: (1) confirm whether customer-managed KMS is required for this POC, (2) confirm logging/audit retention for API calls. Also, if PHI is involved we need to document our redaction flow.

Jordan Lee: Pricing note — for a 2-week hosted trial we usually keep charges minimal (credits). If they require Dedicated GPU burst or sustained throughput for eval, we need to estimate GPU-hours. Rough ballpark for a small retrieval+generate workload: $150–$400/day depending on concurrency. I can produce a quick estimate if we know expected qps and avg tokens.

Maya Patel: AcmeHealth — for Snowflake the simplest is a read-only role + a view that limits columns. If they prefer S3 we can accept a presigned PUT for CSV. Example presign CLI we send customers:

```bash
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-trials/acmehealth/sample.csv --expires-in 3600
```

Or Snowflake grant example I usually ask for from customers:

```sql
CREATE ROLE RW_TRIAL_READ_ONLY;
GRANT USAGE ON DATABASE "CUSTOMER_DB" TO ROLE RW_TRIAL_READ_ONLY;
GRANT SELECT ON SCHEMA "PUBLIC" TO ROLE RW_TRIAL_READ_ONLY;
GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA "PUBLIC" TO ROLE RW_TRIAL_READ_ONLY;
```

Maya Patel: For redaction, propose they strip or mask these columns server-side before transfer: patient_name, ssn, contact_email. If they need us to ingest raw PHI (not preferred), we require customer-managed KMS + SOC checklist signed.

Elena Ruiz (AcmeHealth): We can provide a de-id export with patient_name removed and emails hashed. We still need to validate that the model won't memorize rare PHI — what's your retention/audit policy?

Samir Shah: We retain request logs for 30 days by default in Hosted with option to extend for Dedicated. All logs are encrypted at rest; we support customer-managed KMS for Private deployments. Audit trail (who called which route + model version) is available in Console. I'll attach the SOC/DPA checklist items in a follow-up.

Alex Kim: Eval success criteria (proposal):
- Functional: entity extraction + redaction achieves >= 98% recall on named-entity tags in the sample eval set.
- Quality: generation answers match gold-standard for 80% of sampled prompts (human eval).
- Performance: 99th-percentile generation latency < 450ms for single-turn prompts at target concurrency.
- Ops: secure connectivity verified, credentials rotated, and audit events visible in Console.

Jordan Lee: For the prompt/eval plan I'd suggest 200 prompts across common intents (retrieval QA, summarization, extraction). We'll run a small human eval and return pass/fail. If they need embeddings and reranking, call that out — cost increases due to vector ops.

Maya Patel: I'll provision a trial environment with a Snowflake read-only connection and an S3 staging bucket (if they prefer upload) by tomorrow. Need Elena to confirm: (1) Snowflake role + read-only user OR (2) provide presigned S3 URL for upload. Also indicate whether they want IP-restricted endpoints or VPC peering.

Elena Ruiz (AcmeHealth): We'll provide Snowflake read-only role. IP restriction preferred over peering for this short trial. We'll send role details and a sample de-id CSV by Tues morning.

deploy-bot: sandbox/redwood-trials-acmehealth created — creds placeholder sent to Maya via 1:1.

Alex Kim: Great. Maya and Samir, please collate a short kickoff doc for ACME with the redaction checklist, the eval plan, and the estimated cost table. Jordan, can you drop a simple price table (hosted minimal vs hosted + dedicated burst) by EOD?

Jordan Lee: On it — will post numbers in this thread by 5pm. :thumbsup:

Maya Patel: I'll assemble the onboard doc and share a link.

Elena Ruiz (AcmeHealth): Thanks everyone — looking forward to trial. Will send the sample and role tonight.

Alex Kim: Thanks — we'll circle back once we have the sample.
